input.title: Bump mermaid from 11.15.0 to 11.16.1 in /ui-tests
input.bodyText:
Bumps mermaid from 11.15.0 to 11.16.1.

Release notes
Sourced from mermaid's releases.

mermaid@11.16.1
Patch Changes


#8022 12d472c Thanks @alice! - fix: handle CSS sibling combinators in compileCSS


#8022 2cd6dcf Thanks @alice! - fix: increase protections against prototype pollution
User-controlled input already has protections against prototype pollution.
Fixes: GHSA-c4c3-pg64-4m4v


#8022 99af3fc Thanks @alice! - fix(architecture): use Maps and Sets to store groups/services
Services are now rendered in the order they are defined and more service IDs
are now supported.


#8022 2cd6dcf Thanks @alice! - deprecate: Deprecate the mermaidAPI.setConfig() function
Calling this function has no observable effect, as the next time a
render() or parse() is called, the currentConfig is cleared.


#8022 630aa7e Thanks @alice! - fix(xychart): support zero-width x-axis ranges


#8022 59b22fa Thanks @alice! - fix(radar): limit number of ticks to 32
Setting a ticks value higher than this would only show 32 ticks.
